newsitem.title: USA: Warner-Lambert Q1 hurt by foreign exchange.
newsitem.headline: Warner-Lambert Q1 hurt by foreign exchange.

text.p: Warner-Lambert Co said Tuesday its first quarter results were hurt by foreign exchange rates and softness in its consumer businesses.
The company reported lower first quarter sales and net income.
It said worldwide sales from its pharmaceutical segment grew four percent, to $686 million, while U.S. sales rose 13 percent, to $367 million.

In the consumer health care segment, worldwide sales declined six percent to $662 million. Sales declined one percent to $326 million in the U.S. and decreased nine percent to $336 million outside the U.S., or four percent at constant foreign exchange rates.

In the confectionery segment, worldwide sales fell nine percent to $429 million. Sales in the U.S. decreased three percent to $125 million, while sales in non-U.S. markets declined 11 percent to $304 million.
Sales results in each segment would have been higher at constant foreign exchange rates, it said.
